newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia Yield Spreads-Tighten to U.S.,more to go.
newsitem.headline: Australia Yield Spreads-Tighten to U.S.,more to go.

text.p: The Australian bond market outperformed the dollar bloc and saw the 10-year spread to the U.S. through 50 basis points to around levels not seen since the early 1980's.
And "It's going to go tighten further because the U.S. is definitely in a different stage of the cycle than where Australia is," said Stephen Roberts, chief economist at UBS Australia.

Although local activity remained light, the market retained a firm tone in front of Thursday's labour force data for June amid expectations that even a strong rebound in employment on the month will not alter the overall gloomy jobs picture.

The local market also outperformed Canada, which succumbed to a mild correction on Tuesday after its recent strong rally, while New Zealand debt was under pressure following comments by Treasurer Winston Peters that he saw further weakness in the new Zealand dollar.
